## International Indentation Workshop at University of Hyderabad

News Date : 22 Dec 2023News ReportDate: December 22nd, 2023.The students of the Department of Metallurgical and Materials Engineering, MGIT have attended the 7th International Workshop on Indentation organized by the School of Engineering Sciences and Technology, University of Hyderabad during December 17th to 21th , 2023.The students have informed that the workshop had been of great help to them in building their fundamentals and understanding the cutting edge technologies across the globe.

Date: December 22nd, 2023.
The students of the Department of Metallurgical and Materials Engineering, MGIT have attended the 7th International Workshop on Indentation organized by the School of Engineering Sciences and Technology, University of Hyderabad during December 17th to 21th , 2023.
The students have informed that the workshop had been of great help to them in building their fundamentals and understanding the cutting edge technologies across the globe.
